payload.title: File:Tropidosuchus romeri left hemimandible.jpg
payload.artist_html: Claudio A. Mamani, M. Jimena Trotteyn, Fernando E. Novas, Julia B. Desojo and Martín D. Ezcurra
payload.description_html: Digital reconstruction of the left hemimandible of Tropidosuchus romeri (PVL 4604) in (a) lateral view; (b) medial view; (c) medial view without splenial; (d) dorsal view; (e) ventral view; and (f) ventral view without splenial. al, alveolus; an, angular; ar, articular; dt, dentary; emf, external mandibular fenestra; glf, glenoid fossa; lp, lobe-shaped process; Mgr, Meckelian groove; part, prearticular; pdp, posterodorsal process; pvp, posteroventral process; rarp, retroarticular process; sa, surangular; sash, surangular shelf; spl, splenial; sy, symphysis; te, teeth. Scale bars equal 5 mm.
